instruction.text: Jordan has 37 sweets. Select the number 37 on the grid.

His friend Ellen has 52 sweets.
How many sweets do they have altogether?
Count up from 37 and select the correct number on the grid.
Milo picked 45 apples from his grandparents’ orchard. Select the number 45 on the grid.

Milo picks another 13 apples.
How many apples does Milo have now?
Count up from 45 and select the correct number on the grid.
Jasmin has 77 stickers. Select the number 77 on the grid.

Jasmin gives her younger sister 26 stickers.
How many stickers does Jasmin have now?
Count down from 77 and select the correct number on the grid.
Farrah has baked 68 cupcakes for the school bake sale. Select the number 68 on the grid.

Farrah sells 34 cupcakes.
How many cupcakes is Farrah left with?
Count down from 68 and select the correct number on the grid.
